summary: DC Vote has documented recent attacks on the District's local authority and highlighted responses to them. A senator has committed to prioritizing DC statehood, while advocates have marked the anniversary of a federal takeover as evidence for why statehood is urgent. Without statehood, Congress reviews the District's laws and can vote to repeal them.

articles.title: Nine Attacks on DC’s Local Authority, and How We Responded
VIDEO: Senator Slotkin Commits to Making DC Statehood a Top Priority
One Year Later, DC Vote Says Federal Takeover Underscores the Urgency of DC Statehood
